items.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The transcript mentions John Mayall only in a list of artists who covered 'Parchman Farm' provided by the interviewer; Mose Allison does not mention any personal interaction or relationship with John Mayall.

ctx.x: The Yardbirds. Gosh, a whole bunch. I’m trying to remember who else. Johnny Winters. Didn’t he do “Parchman Farm”?
this clip from All About Jazz states that “Parchman Farm” was covered by Johnny Winter, Cactus, Blue Cheer, Rick Derringer, John Mayall, and Hot Tuna.
